topic: How does the 11.6% bandwidth of the CTS antenna influence frequency planning and spectral efficiency for broadband satellite links?
consensus_response: The 11.6% bandwidth of the CTS antenna significantly influences frequency planning and spectral efficiency by reducing available channels, increasing interference between adjacent beams, and necessitating complex channel allocation methods to accommodate varying traffic demands. This limitation reduces spectral efficiency, affecting system performance and capacity per beam. The narrow bandwidth also impacts adaptive coding techniques, such as LDPC codes, which may not fully compensate for the reduced spectral efficiency.
reference_context: The CTS antenna's 11.6% bandwidth constrains frequency planning, reducing available channels for downlinking (BWd) and uplinking (BWu), leading to increased interference between adjacent beams. The average used bandwidth is constrained, affecting overall system performance and capacity.
